parsed.reason: The message contains no attribution showing that Hale took a look for this family. The facts are stated as information without any first-person verb of finding or checking ("I found", "I checked", "I looked up"). The message reads like a collection of trivia indistinguishable from facts a stranger sent. It includes invented specifics (Sunnyside Splash Pad details, Beaches Rec Centre program, specific times and dates, September 3 opening) that were not in the family's postal code or area information provided to Hale. This reads as product introduction and hype ("There is honestly so much going on around you this week") rather than reporting back on work already done for this specific family.
